note: Repo source of truth for the guardrails attached in the Gradient console. evals/lib/guardrails.mjs is the reference implementation used by the offline eval; the console uses Gradient's built-in sensitive-data + jailbreak guardrails configured to match this.

anonymization.when: Applied to the inbound user message BEFORE it is logged, cached, or sent to any tool/model call. Logs and traces store ONLY the redacted text.
anonymization.names_note: Personal NAMES are anonymized by the platform's sensitive-data guardrail (NER), not by regex here. The regex set above covers structured PII. Do not log raw names.
anonymization.geo_exception: Map coordinates and neighborhood/street names the vendor is ASKING ABOUT (e.g. 'Folsom & 2nd') are operational data, not PII, and are not redacted. Only a self-identifying home/personal STREET_ADDRESS pattern is redacted; the agents work with map_center/pinned_point lat/lng which are never PII.

jailbreak.refusal_markdown: I can help with finding a good spot to vend or getting your SF permits in order, but I can't do that. Ask me where to set up, or which permits your truck/trailer/cart needs.

logging.rule: Never log raw user input. Pipeline: receive -> anonymize() -> (route/answer) -> log(anonymized_input, agent, latency). Tool call payloads that echo user text are anonymized too. PII tokens above are the only thing that reaches logs/traces.
